summary: Retrieve a filtered list of album entities.
description: Select and filter album entities, returning the main fields concerning albums. Includes the new 'zip_allowed' boolean indicating whether a download zip is permitted and notes that the 'zip' field will be empty when 'zip_allowed' is false. Supports pagination, ordering, and various search filters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 10, max 200. Using 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify order (ascending is default, rating fields default to descending).

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes 'results_fullcount' (total rows without limit/offset). Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter albums released between two dates (format yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired cover image size in pixels.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for file URLs; only 'mp32' (mp3 192kbps) is supported.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Select releases of a certain type. Defaults to both albums and singles.

notes: Since February 2021 the response includes a boolean field 'zip_allowed' indicating if a download zip can be offered.
From April 2022, if 'zip_allowed' is false the 'zip' field will be an empty string.
The endpoint does not include the version prefix in the path; use '/albums' as shown.
